receipts.setActivePage: Focused a page on the canvas

workbench.redesignPrompt: Please redesign the whole educational piece from the current design and pages. Keep character continuity and strengthen each page's learning takeaway and practical safety guidance. Use actions: set_design plus upsert_pages with mode "replace" for a complete new board. Only add generate_images if new frames are clearly needed.
workbench.defaultReply: Updated the education-first global design and storyboard pages.

brief.description: Edit any part of the draft before moving into image generation

defaults.summary: A practical and encouraging public safety story that turns preparation into a simple action people can remember
defaults.visualDirection: Clean editorial composition with warm natural light, confident subjects, clear gestures, and a calm orange accent
defaults.imagePrompt: Editorial social media image showing a family preparing a compact emergency kit on a bright kitchen table, documentary realism, calm confident mood, clean composition, high detail
defaults.captionDirection: Keep the caption useful and reassuring with one memorable action and a simple call to prepare today

images.title: Plan pages and generate images
images.description: AI splits the brief into page ideas, generates one image set per page, and you confirm selections here
images.waitingImages: No images for this page yet
images.noPageResult: The model returned no usable page plan.
images.emptyDescription: The agent will split the brief into page ideas and prompts, then generate visuals page by page.
images.refinePlaceholder: For example: keep the character unchanged, move the scene to a rooftop, and make the light brighter…
images.noImageResult: The model returned no image. Check that your Poe model is an image model.
images.agentError: Image generation failed. Check the Poe model name, points, and network connection.
images.promptHint: The prompt can be edited and regenerated at any time

gallery.title: Review the gallery
gallery.description: Choose the image that will carry the story into the final caption and audio

caption.description: Write Cantonese narration and timings first, then generate voice variants

options.one: A small preparation today can make a big difference when the weather changes
options.two: Keep the essentials close, keep the plan simple, and help your family feel ready
options.three: Prepared does not have to be complicated — start with one useful kit and one clear conversation
